scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A father gestures as he teaches his son beneath an olive tree in a sunlit stone courtyard. The boy sits on a woven mat, looking up at him with one hand over his heart. Clay vessels, a bowl of olives, village buildings, and distant hills surround them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a father teaching his son, suggesting Proverbs 3:1's call to remember the teaching and keep its commands in the heart.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A white-haired man with a walking staff holds a smiling child's hand as they walk along a sunlit path through olive trees. A stone house, hills, and a low sun appear in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of generations on a peaceful path, reflecting Proverbs 3:2's length of days, years of life, and peace.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a kneeling young person offers a bowl of water to an older seated traveler. A red-and-gold braided necklace holds a blank heart-shaped pendant at the person's chest; a donkey and clay jars are nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of Proverbs 3:3: the intertwined cords and heart-shaped pendant evoke binding mercy and truth close and writing them on the heart, while the offered water pictures mercy.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man kneels at a sunlit stone village gate, offering a cup to a seated elder holding a walking staff as smiling villagers look on; olive branches and a hillside village fill the background.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of kindness and community esteem reflects Proverbs 3:4's finding favor and high esteem in the sight of God and people.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated traveler rests one hand over his heart and looks toward sunlight breaking through clouds. A parchment lies on a rock beside him, with olive trees, a winding path, distant hills, and a village around him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests trusting Yahweh with one's whole heart instead of leaning on one's own understanding; the set-aside parchment is a visual metaphor.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed traveler kneels with hands clasped beside a sunlit path under an olive tree. The path runs between stone walls toward villages, trees, and mountains in a golden valley.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a traveler praying as a path opens ahead, evoking Proverbs 3:6's call to acknowledge God and His direction of one's paths.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded traveler kneels at a fork in a rocky hillside, head bowed and one hand against his chest, as he touches a small bronze mirror on a stone. A dark, thorn-choked path lies behind him, while a sunlit path winds past olive trees toward distant houses and hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative visual metaphor for Proverbs 3:7: the traveler sets aside self-regard, bows in reverence to the LORD, and turns away from the thorny path.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling man in a cream tunic stands with one hand on his abdomen and the other touching an olive tree with exposed roots beside a clear stream; a sunlit village and hills lie beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggesting the verse's health for the flesh and strength for the bones through the man's steady posture and the well-watered, rooted tree.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A kneeling farmer places a woven basket of figs and grapes beside a sheaf of grain on a low stone platform, with a fig tree, grapevines, a golden field, and a distant village behind him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of honoring God with one's possessions and the firstfruits of one's increase, inspired by Proverbs 3:9.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A sunlit stone granary piled high with golden grain stands beside stone vats overflowing with dark red wine, surrounded by grapevines and baskets of grapes.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative harvest scene illustrating Proverbs 3:10's barns filled with plenty and vats overflowing with new wine.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A father points as a boy steadies a young tree tied to a wooden support in a sunlit garden, with stone terraces, olive trees, hills, and a distant village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a father guiding his son, echoing Proverbs 3:11's call not to despise Yahweh's discipline or detest his correction.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A father rests a hand on his son's shoulder as they kneel together and plant a young tree in a sunlit olive grove, with a stone village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined father guiding his son evokes the verse's comparison between the Lord's loving correction and a father's delight in his son.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling man crouches beneath an olive tree, holding a lit clay lamp beside a rocky path. Olive groves, hills, and a village stretch into the sunset.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative image of the joy of finding wisdom and gaining understanding in Proverbs 3:13; the lamp and path are visual metaphors.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older teacher gestures toward a fruit-laden fig tree while a young learner listens in a sunlit village courtyard; an open chest of silver coins and gold sits nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggesting that wisdom's gain is better than the profit of silver and fine gold in Proverbs 3:14.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A young person listens to an older woman who gestures beneath an olive tree. An open chest of red gems and gold jewelry rests nearby, with a village and hills in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of wisdom as a woman offering counsel, with rubies set aside, reflecting Proverbs 3:15's comparison of wisdom with precious things.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a sunlit landscape holds a leafy olive branch in her right hand and a shallow dish of gold coins and a golden circlet in her left. A younger traveler and an elder walk together along a winding path among olive trees and distant stone houses.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative portrayal of Wisdom uses the olive branch and long path to suggest length of days in her right hand, and the coins and circlet to suggest riches and honor in her left, as in Proverbs 3:16.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a green head covering holds a child's hand and gestures toward winding paths through an olive grove and wildflowers, with a village and mountains beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene personifies wisdom as a woman guiding a child along pleasant paths, reflecting Proverbs 3:17's picture of her ways as pleasant and her paths as peace.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a warm watercolor scene, two adults and two children smile while holding the trunk and low branches of a large fig tree, with wildflowers, rolling hills and a small village beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of Proverbs 3:18: wisdom is a tree of life to those who take hold of her, and those who retain her are happy.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor landscape with exposed layers of bedrock beneath green hills and trees, snowcapped mountains, and a blue sea, under a glowing cloud-filled sky that deepens into stars.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a firm earth beneath an ordered sky, reflecting Proverbs 3:19's description of Yahweh founding the earth by wisdom and establishing the heavens by understanding.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A foaming spring pours from a cleft in a rocky hillside into a stream, while droplets hang beneath dawn clouds and bead on leaves; sunlit hills stretch into the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 3:20: water emerging from split rock suggests the depths broken open by God's knowledge, while the clouds and droplets evoke dew.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: On a rocky hillside path at sunset, a man holding a staff points toward a distant village while a boy holds a lit clay lamp and looks up at him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative father-and-son scene uses the lamp as a reminder of Proverbs 3:21: keep sound wisdom and discretion in sight.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling woman in a white robe and head covering holds a leafy sapling in soil and wears a gold leaf necklace beside flowing water in a sunlit garden.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Proverbs 3:22: the sapling and spring suggest life for the soul, while the necklace evokes grace for the neck.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A sandaled traveler walks along a sunlit path bordered by stones and wildflowers, with trees, a village, and mountains in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene echoes Proverbs 3:23 by showing a traveler walking safely without stumbling.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man sleeps on his side under a red and cream woven blanket in a stone room. An oil lamp glows on a shelf, and olive trees and a distant village are visible through an open window beneath a starry sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of peaceful sleep illustrates Proverbs 3:24's promise of lying down without fear and sleeping sweetly.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed traveler with a staff and satchel stands on a rocky path, calmly looking toward a vast dust cloud over a distant stone settlement where small figures move.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a traveler facing an approaching disturbance, reflecting Proverbs 3:25's call not to fear sudden terror or trouble associated with the wicked when it comes.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A sandaled traveler carrying a pack and staff steps onto a rock beyond a loose rope snare, looking toward the sun above a hillside village and distant mountains.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 3:26: Yahweh is the reader's confidence and keeps their foot from being caught.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A standing man hands a leather pouch to a kneeling worker beside a hoe in a sunlit stone courtyard, with an olive tree and baskets of grapes and grain.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imagined payment of wages illustrates Proverbs 3:27's instruction to give good to those to whom it is due when it is within one's power.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village, a neighbor holds out empty hands toward a man in a doorway. The man raises one hand and points away with the other, while a basket of bread sits within reach beside him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 3:28's warning against asking a neighbor to return tomorrow when the means to help are already at hand.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village, a man relaxes with a cup beside his doorway while another crouches behind a low wall, holding a cord attached to a loop on the shared path.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 3:29: the peaceful neighbor's trust contrasts with the concealed snare, illustrating the warning against devising harm toward a neighbor who dwells securely beside you.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures with an open hand toward a calm neighbor holding a clay water jar beside a stone well, with sunlit buildings, trees, and fields behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative moment of restraint evokes the proverb's counsel not to quarrel without cause with someone who has done no harm.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village marketplace, a richly dressed man holding a basket of fruit offers coins to a kneeling young traveler, who raises a hand while gathering spilled produce near an anxious seated seller.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Proverbs 3:31's warning not to envy an oppressor or choose his ways: the traveler refuses his offer and helps the seller.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Five people gather beneath a fig tree in a sunlit stone courtyard; a man gestures as the others listen, while a merchant holds a weight beside a balance at a nearby stall.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests God's secret counsel with the upright through a quiet gathering, contrasted with a merchant who hints at crooked conduct, echoing Proverbs 3:32.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a watercolor village, rain falls from a dark cloud over a closed, weathered house and dry plants. Across a path, four people share bread outside a sunlit home surrounded by green vines and grapes.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Proverbs 3:33's contrast between Yahweh's curse on the house of the wicked and His blessing on the home of the just.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man helps a kneeling woman in worn clothes in a sunny stone courtyard, while two ornately dressed men recoil from a gust of wind.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 3:34: the gust suggests God's scorn toward the scornful, while the helping hand and sunlight suggest grace given to the afflicted or humble.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an elder holds a leafy wreath above a seated man's head while a woman beside him holds olive branches. Nearby, two men look dismayed beside an overturned water jar and a fallen wreath.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of Proverbs 3:35's contrast between the wise inheriting glory and fools receiving shame.
